text: [angry, fast] Spineless! Sunderland bullied us, and not one of our lot stood up.
Chelsea lose one-nil at Sunderland and drop out of the top four. One question. Is it Xabi... or the players?
[laughing in disbelief] Estêvão on the bench? Against Sunderland? Ha! Xabi, my brother, what are you doing?
[passionate, raised voice] Give Xabi time! They got outmuscled for ninety minutes. That's on the players, not him.
[tired, quiet] New shape every week. [sighs] The players don't know their jobs any more. That's the coach.
[calm, firm] Neither. Look upstairs. New manager, same old problems, every single season.
Think you'd pick a better team? On ACTXION, Starting 11 sends your XI for Leeds to the club and the manager.
Xabi, or the players? You tell us.
